d: Gallery in the palace, corresponding to various apartments. The King, and Great of the kingdom are all in various attitudes of fear and desolation: facing the sky they intuit the following
Geneva, Dalinda, Damigelle, and sayings.
Guinevere, Dalinda, Damigelle, who remain in the background.
Royal gardens, Polinesso indi Dalinda.
Dalinda.

Large, magnificent earthly lodges, with sight of the royal gardens, pompously adorned by the triumph of Ariodante. Great of the kingdom, Warriors, Royal Guards, People, who festive before the King, who comes with Geneva, who is followed by Dalinda, who carries on a rich kiss a crown of laurel, Damigelle, Polinesso is near the King.

At the sound of lively martial music, the Scottish and British armies begin to parade on the scene, which lead between them chained the Irish prisoners: afterward the dukes appear, and the squires over haughty steeds carrying the flags, and the trophies conquered. Then the triumphal chariot appears, pulled by Irish prisoners, on which Ariodante is seated. Lurcanio with' squires follows him: meanwhile, everyone sings the following
Lurcanio and Dalinda.
Royal gardens, statues, fountains, avenues, palace table, etc.Ariodante and Polinesso.
Vafrin, for the part where Ariodante entered.

Night with moon. Prospect on one side of the palace, which concerns the uninhabited part of the city, with viable verone. On the other side, of the ancient and ruinous houses. Almost in prospect bridge over the river, which runs along the palace. Ariodant, it comes out concentrated, at a slow pace, then Lurcanio.
Polinex, then Dalinda on the veron, and sayings.
Ariodant coming out of his turn, then Lurcanio.
Lurcanio, Indi Guerrieri, Scudieri and Popolo with face on.
Poliness who comes from the palace, opposes them, and in a majestic and proud tone.
Part of the palace corresponding to apartments: lights on. The King goes out agitated. Two guards remain at the bottom, then Geneva in a simple dress, with head without ornaments.
Polinesso, Lurcanio, Duci, Guerrieri, Scudieri, People advance from the bottom of the scene.
Remote place outside the city, which corresponds to the sea on one side, and to the Solitari wood on the other. Vafrino exits painfully from the sea side, and then Dalinda.
Dalinda, who comes out hurled running away: two shepherds with bare daggers chase her, and Vafrino.

A lavish building is on one side with towers and spires. It serves as a retreat to the Solitaries of Scotland; and it is part hidden from the trees, which clutter the whole scene. Ariodante appears from the bottom of the forest. Everything in it is a dark passion; slowly it is advanced immersed in deep thought. Geme, sighs; then, as shaking, looking around always advancing.

The door of the building is opened, and many Solitaries come out, going to scatter themselves by the wood, among some of them the Great Solitary. They show much pain, and scattered by the woods, singing in
The King, then Lurcanio.
Lurcanio.
Geneva Cabinets. Geneva surrounded by its Damigelle who mourn it; then the King, with Grands, Guards, etc.
The King, Great, Guards.

Magnificent place of the palace. Guards are arranged for the scene: many Great and Dukes scattered in an attitude of pain, then Polyness, then the King with Geneva, Damigelle etc.The Great meanwhile intuit the following
The King, Geneva, Donzelle, Guards, ind Lurcanio with Polinesso.
Ariodant, in black armor with face closed in the visor, and sayings.
Geneva, and Ariodante.

Great square of the city. In the middle fenced for fighters. Rogo on one side, loggias around the crowd of the spectator People. One in the prospect for the king, and Grandi. At the sound of soft music, follows great march, in which Poliness appears armed with usbergo, and helmet, with 'Great. Then on one side Lurcanio, then on the other Ariodante, both followed by two Shields, who carry the sword and the shield. Then the King with Geneva, followed by 'Gravi, Damigelle etc.. Meanwhile, the following is sung:
Vafrin and sayings.
Dalinda, who runs to kneel forward Geneva, and sayings.
